<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     references.qmd — REFERENCES
     
     Quarto automatically renders your references.bib file here.
     You do not need to type anything in this file.
     
     ✏️  WHAT TO DO:
       1. Export your Zotero library (or add entries manually)
          to the references.bib file in this project folder.
       2. In your .qmd chapter files, cite using [@AuthorYear].
       3. Only sources you actually cited will appear here —
          Quarto filters automatically.
       4. The APA style is applied via the apa.csl file included
          in this project. Do not change the csl: field in _quarto.yml
          unless you need a different citation style.
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
